name: Shiba Ryuuji
source: Teacher at Ootori Academy and director of Kiageha theater troupe. Ryuji was highly sought-after in his youth for his talent as both an actor and playwright, but retired from theater for reasons unknown. He got the job teaching and directing at Ootori through the influence of an aquiantance.
translation: Teacher at Ootori Academy and director of Kiageha theater troupe. Ryuji was highly sought-after in his youth for his talent as both an actor and playwright, but retired from theater for reasons unknown. He got the job teaching and directing at Ootori through the influence of an aquiantance.
